messages.subject: Kingsgate House – additional CPSE enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Zoe,

Following our review of the draft replies, please address the following additional enquiries: (1) confirmation of the option to tax notification and HMRC acknowledgement; (2) any service charge arrears or disputes with the occupational tenants; (3) details of the section 106 obligation referred to in the local search and confirmation of compliance; and (4) confirmation that there are no outstanding rent reviews.

Many thanks,
Elena Marchetti
Associate, Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Kingsgate House – additional CPSE enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Our replies to your additional enquiries and the full CPSE.1 replies are now finalised and in the data room. In short: (1) option to tax notified with effect from 1 April 2014, copy enclosed; (2) no service charge arrears or tenant disputes; (3) the s106 obligation relates to the 2009 refurbishment and was certified compliant on 14 May 2010; (4) no rent reviews outstanding.

Kind regards,
Zoe Abbott
Marlowe Greaves LLP
